el.Hace más de diez años acompaño a alumnas: For over ten years I have been guiding Yoga students and teachers to deepen their practice and find their own way of teaching.
el.Todas mis propuestas parten desde una mi: All my programs start from a holistic perspective, taking Patanjali's Yoga Sutras as their philosophical framework and combining it with a modern, creative approach.
el.Dirijo el Instructorado y el Posgrado en: I direct the Teacher Training and the Postgraduate in Yoga Esencial, lead an ongoing study group, teach weekly Hatha Yoga classes, support projects through one-on-one mentoring, and bring Yoga practices to retreats and experiences.

el.Devoluciones de alumnas y alumnos de las: Feedback from students of Piku Yoga's trainings.
el.Piku Yoga es el espacio de formación y p: Piku Yoga is the Yoga training and practice space of Piku Montiel, a Yoga teacher with more than ten years of experience. Everything is taught online, live on Zoom and with recorded classes, from any country.
el.La formación anual es Yoga Esencial. Se: The annual training is Yoga Esencial. It takes place in two stages: the Teacher Training, from March to August, and the Postgraduate, from September to November. You can take them together or separately.
el.¿Hace falta formación previa para empeza: Do I need prior training to start?
el.No. El Instructorado en Yoga Esencial es: No. The Yoga Esencial Teacher Training is designed for starting from scratch. The Postgraduate, however, is for those who have already trained or already teach.
el.¿Las clases son en vivo o grabadas?: Are the classes live or recorded?
They are live on Zoom and they are recorded. If you can't make it at the scheduled time, you watch the recording whenever you can and keep up with the course all the same.
el.¿Desde qué países se puede cursar?: Which countries can I join from?
el.Desde cualquiera. Las clases son online: Any of them. Classes are online and in Spanish, and schedules are set in Argentina time.
el.Escribiendo por WhatsApp. Ahí Piku te cu: Just send a message on WhatsApp. Piku will walk you through the payment options and reserve your spot.
el.¿No sabés cuál es la propuesta ideal par: Not sure which program is right for you?
el.Contame en qué estás y en qué momento de: Tell me where you are and what stage of your practice you're in, and we'll figure out the next step together.
